title: Letter 74
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Letters of St. Jerome > Letter 74

paragraphs.text: {{BIBLE:1ki 3:16}} . This Jerome gives at length, treating the narrative as a parable and making the false and true mothers types of the Synagogue and the Church. The date of the letter is 398 A.D.

source_note: Source. Translated by W.H. Fremantle, G. Lewis and W.G. Martley. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 6. Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace.
